resources.title: Azure SQL Architecture Explained Infographic (1 of 3)
resources.description: A side-by-side breakdown of Azure's three SQL deployment options: Azure SQL Database (fully-managed PaaS, best for new cloud apps), Azure SQL Managed Instance (PaaS with near-full SQL Server compatibility and cross-database queries), and SQL Server on an Azure VM (IaaS, full OS/SQL control, needed for SSIS/SSRS/SSAS). Includes a feature-by-feature comparison table (SQL Server compatibility, cross-database queries, SSIS/SSRS/SSAS support, high availability, backups/patching, scaling, typical use case), a real on-premises-to-Azure migration example, and the key concepts (vCores/DTUs, HA, backup & restore, networking, cost management) every Azure Database Engineer works with.

resources.title: Azure Database Engineer: High Availability, Backup & Disaster Recovery Infographic (2 of 3)
resources.description: How to keep business-critical Azure databases available, protected, and recoverable: geo-replication between a primary and failover region, zone redundancy, failover groups, automatic backups with point-in-time restore, and long-term retention. Walks through a real retailer region-outage scenario step by step (normal operations, outage detected, failover initiated, traffic moves, business continues, recovery & resync), a feature comparison table (zone redundancy vs. geo-replication vs. failover groups vs. backups vs. point-in-time restore vs. long-term retention), and the key Azure services involved (Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance, Azure Backup, Azure Monitor, Failover Groups).

resources.title: Azure Database Engineer: Performance, Security & Automation Infographic (3 of 3)
resources.description: The real day-to-day job of an Azure Database Engineer: monitoring and performance optimization (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Query Store, DMVs, a real Azure Portal dashboard with CPU/DTU/storage/connection metrics), security & access control (Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, private endpoints, TDE, auditing, network security), automation & DevOps (PowerShell/Azure CLI, infrastructure as code with Bicep/Terraform, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automated patching and alerting), a real slow-query troubleshooting walkthrough (identify, analyze with Query Store, optimize, validate, monitor continuously), and a real incident-recovery scenario (detection, failover, recovery, resync).
